description:
The AI Solutions Engineer designs, implements, and continuously improves AI capabilities, both in MEDHOST products and in the tools our teams use to build them. This person turns business and clinical problems into secure, compliant, production-ready AI solutions. They also lead the design and improvement of our internal AI tools.

 You’ll partner with Product, Engineering, QA, Security, and Compliance to turn AI ideas into working, production-quality solutions. As a trusted advisor to business and technical stakeholders, you’ll spread proven practices across teams and work directly with customers to support AI solution design and rollout.

 You’ll help define the patterns, guardrails, and evaluation standards that let teams build and run AI features safely and repeatably.

 The AI Solutions Engineer is remote within the U.S. and Canada. 

 Key Responsibilities: 
 Deliver AI-powered product features and agents, deployed either in products for customers or as internal digital workers
 Build end-to-end agentic AI systems, including orchestration, tool use, memory, model routing, failure handling, and cost control. Identify when a deterministic workflow is the better fit, and keep the platform current as new models and frameworks emerge
 Lead AI-accelerated delivery from prototype to production. Integrate models and agents with enterprise knowledge, APIs, tools, and transactional systems
 Work directly with customers as needed to understand requirements, support AI deployments, and gather feedback
 Establish practices for AI evaluation, regression testing, observability, drift, latency and cost monitoring
 Capture and codify lessons learned from implementation work into shared best practices, including a consistent AI-DLC methodology for applying AI across the product development lifecycle
 Run hands-on early-stage initiatives, proof-of-concepts, and first-of-a-kind projects to validate feasibility, unblock teams, or accelerate product development
 Define, track, and report KPIs for AI solutions in both product and internal tools (for example, output quality, accuracy, reliability, cycle time, rework, and cost). Share results with stakeholders regularly and use them to prioritize improvements
 Champion responsible AI principles, including fairness, transparency, privacy, and accountability
 Facilitate workshops and deliver presentations focused on AI best practices
  
  
 Requirements and Qualifications: 
 Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience) and 5+ years of software engineering or architecture experience
 Proven experience leading or influencing initiatives across product, business, and technical domains
 Strong understanding of core AI concepts, including large language models, ML workflows, prompt and context engineering, and agent orchestration
 Hands-on technical depth. Strong, demonstrated expertise with Claude or Codex, including building reusable skills, context engineering and working with code graphs
 Commitment to keeping up with the AI industry's latest news, concepts, and technologies
 Excellent communication skills, able to convey technical concepts to non-technical audiences
 Awareness of data governance, responsible AI principles, and regulatory considerations
 Experience designing and running evaluation strategies for non-deterministic AI systems
 Solid understanding of software architecture, APIs, cloud platforms, and CI/CD practices
 Experience working in regulated environments, and a strong grasp of data privacy, security, and responsible-AI principles
  
 What Will Set You Apart: 
 Hands-on experience with spec-driven development, using structured specifications to guide AI implementation, testing, and validation
 Experience in healthcare technology, including familiarity with healthcare regulations (such as HIPAA) and clinical, financial, or hospital workflows
 A track record of taking AI solutions from proof of concept to production and improving them over time with measurable results
 Experience building developer tools or AI-assisted software development lifecycle tooling, including Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent SDKs, or multi-agent systems
 Active engagement with the AI community and up to date on emerging tools, frameworks, and integration best practices
 Familiarity with Amazon Bedrock, self-hosting LLMs, and Claude Code
   
 What We Offe r:
 Salary range: $110,000 - $150,000 USD per year .
  
 Plenty of opportunities to grow your career
 Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits
 3 weeks of vacation plus 5 personal days to recharge
 Employee stock ownership and RRSP program
 A chance to give back through community involvement
 Flexible work arrangements to suit your lifestyle
  
 About us: 
 MEDHOST, founded in 1984 and headquartered in Franklin, Tennessee, is a leading provider of healthcare information technology solutions. Serving healthcare facilities nationwide, MEDHOST offers a comprehensive suite of products, including electronic health records (EHR), financial management systems, and patient engagement platforms. 

 Their mission is to empower healthcare organizations to enhance patient care and improve business operations through innovative, user-friendly solutions. In January 2024, MEDHOST was acquired by N. Harris Computer Corporation, further strengthening its position in the healthcare IT industry.
  
 About Harris Computer: 
 Harris provides mission critical software solutions for the Public Sector, Healthcare, Utilities and Private Sector verticals throughout North America, Europe, Asia and Australia.

Working for Harris is the perfect opportunity to fulfill your professional goals as well as achieve your personal dreams!

Our employees enjoy a casual work environment that offers comfort while providing superior service to our customers. We offer a comprehensive benefit package as well as other additional “Perks”!
 We empower our employees to make a difference
 We have an award-winning culture
 We offer opportunity to learn
 We are financially strong and we are owned by the largest software company in Canada (CSI)
 We have fun!
